name: Warehouse transfer
description: Verify conservation across North and South warehouse stock transfers.
objective: Click Reset stock. Store the displayed North warehouse quantity text as 'before_north'. Store the displayed South warehouse quantity text as 'before_south'. Enter 40 in Transfer quantity and click Move stock once. Confirm Transfer complete. Store the displayed North warehouse quantity text as 'after_north'. Store the displayed South warehouse quantity text as 'after_south'. Store each quantity as displayed text, then finish.
